overseas.text: Whatever you need, whether for a family reunion, a wedding, a church group, an alumni weekend or a company retreat. First time on the island or coming home? We handle it all. You let us know your needs. We book the rooms, day trips, flights and everything in between.

trips.text: Flights, hotel and private transfers from Kingston or Montego Bay. Ten adults or more. Your group can hold their spots for as little as US$95 each. See what the price looks like.
